lua.name: wsl_client_headers
lua.source:
-- Stamp the visitor's address and country for the origin. Always overwritten,
-- so a client can't supply its own values through the edge.
return function(cfg, ctx, policy)
    ngx.req.set_header("X-WSL-Client-IP", tostring(ctx.client_ip or ngx.var.remote_addr or ""))
    local cc = ngx.var.geo_country
    cc = type(cc) == "string" and cc:upper():gsub("%s+", "") or ""
    if cc == "UK" then cc = "GB" end
    ngx.req.set_header("X-WSL-Geo-Country", cc:match("^%u%u$") and cc or nil)
    return nil
end
